data: What is the approximate highest value of k for which a data point is shown on the graph?

The question asks for the approximate highest value of k for which a data point is shown on the graph. From the analysis of the figure, the x-axis represents the number of principal components (k), and the y-axis represents the attachment score. The data points are represented by red squares and black circles, corresponding to UAS and LAS, respectively. Observing the graph, the data points are plotted up to approximately k = 300. Therefore, the approximate highest value of k for which a data point is shown on the graph is 300.
